# PROVENANCE — derivation record · 推导记录

**Generated by:** harness-factory 0.1.0 on 2026-10-16T23:04:05+00:00  ·  **Domain:** humanities
**Task:** 华严经细读系列（huayan_collection）：依八十华严三十九品次第，逐品独立成篇（三层疏解＋注疏对读＋数据层），经文引文逐字回源 CBETA 繁体底本 T10n0279；跨会话长时程推进；成果发布为静态站点。本 harness 为整仓指导性薄入口，与既有 CLAUDE.md 及 harness/ 并存。

> 中文速览：本文件记录本次 harness 是如何**推导**出来的（可复核的责任链）。无法验证的内容标注 `unverified`。

## Features · 任务特征

horizon=multi_session, verifiability=medium, stakes=high, grounding=required, artifact=document, tool_surface=read_write, collaboration=solo, domain=humanities

## Capabilities · 能力

| capability | rationale |
|---|---|
| baseline-discipline | Baseline discipline — Every task needs load-bearing invariants, curated context, and change governance. |
| verification-gate | Verification gate — Define done before work and verify with observed evidence (M0.3). |
| resumable-memory | Resumable memory — Work that spans a session must externalize state and resume from it. |
| traceable-sources | Traceable sources — Cited material demands every claim trace to a primary source (M0.1). |
| self-improving-loop | Self-improving loop — Multi-session work benefits from an explicit signal→audit→mutation→journal loop (M0.10). |
| tool-use | Tool use — A task that touches the world needs a minimal, progressive toolset. |
| human-review-gate | Human review gate — Others are involved or stakes are high: escalate irreversible decisions (M0.8). |
| high-stakes-guardrails | High-stakes guardrails — When stakes are high, strengthen gates and lower autonomy. |
| long-horizon-autonomy-control | Long-horizon autonomy control — A long, high-stakes run needs durable memory, hard gates, and low autonomy. |
| sandboxed-execution | Sandboxed / least-privilege execution — declare an execution backend and a least-privilege posture rather than running unconstrained (M0.4/M0.8). |
| portable-skills | Portable skills (Agent Skills format) — skills emitted in the SKILL.md open format load in any compatible harness. |
| ambition-elevation | Ambition elevation (raise, then converge) — restate → elevate → classify → offer → confirm (M0.3/M0.4/M0.8). See reference/requirement-refinement.md. |
| expert-instruments | Expert instruments (depth) — use the field's real instruments and an outside judge, not self-grading (M0.2/M0.3). |
| bidirectional-capability-flow | Bidirectional capability flow — concretize locally; distil only as human-gated proposals (M0.4/M0.5/M0.10). See reference/capability-flow.md. |

## Modules · 启用模块（含依据）

| id | module | rule | reasons |
|---|---|---|---|
| M0 | Meta-principles / 元原则 | Truth and traceability outrank speed; automate only observe/record/rank | always: load-bearing invariants (M0); capability: baseline-discipline, ambition-elevation, bidirectional-capability-flow |
| M1 | Context engineering / 上下文工程 | Context is a finite, scarce resource - curate, don't dump | always: context is consumed by every step (M0.6); capability: baseline-discipline |
| M2 | Long-running agents / 长时程 agent | Externalize memory; advance incrementally; make every run resumable | horizon=multi_session >= session; capability: resumable-memory, long-horizon-autonomy-control |
| M3 | Verification & gates / 验证与门禁 | Define done before work; verify the verifier; hard vs soft gates | always: verify before done (M0.3); strictness from verifiability=medium, stakes=high; capability: verification-gate, high-stakes-guardrails, long-horizon-autonomy-control, sandboxed-execution, ambition-elevation, expert-instruments |
| M4 | Provenance & integrity / 来源与完整性 | Every fact traceable to a primary source; uncertain means uncertain | grounding=required, artifact=document; capability: traceable-sources, expert-instruments |
| M5 | Self-evolution / 自演化 | signal -> audit -> mutation -> journal, human-gated | horizon=multi_session >= multi_session; capability: self-improving-loop, bidirectional-capability-flow |
| M6 | Tools & skills / 工具与技能 | Minimal toolset; biased errors; skills load progressively | tool_surface=read_write; capability: tool-use, sandboxed-execution, portable-skills, expert-instruments |
| M7 | Change governance / 变更治理 | Single source of truth; reviewable diffs; no unsolicited destructive acts | always: single source of truth + reviewable diffs (M0.5/M0.9); capability: baseline-discipline, sandboxed-execution, bidirectional-capability-flow |
| M8 | Collaboration & sessions / 协作与会话 | Explicit contracts; escalate decisions; hand off with state | collaboration=solo, stakes=high; capability: human-review-gate, high-stakes-guardrails, long-horizon-autonomy-control, ambition-elevation |
